regulatory_primary.future_restrictions: HYPOTHESIS: individual provider removals, future gated status and legal limitations; no specific deletion date verified for 11 repos

study_questions.H: P0 captures four heterogeneous independent learned outcomes in ~2.235GB publisher source references, and preserving parent/edited pairs offers more recoverable capability than redundant quantizations or additional same-family models.
study_questions.T: Static invariants: 11/11 queue IDs, SHA-pinned source manifest references, phase totals, no overlap with 99 reported VERIFIED IDs, no approvals. For owner testing, local file SHA and 200GB free floor plus exact LICENSE/ABI. For quality comparisons, fixed prompt and environment with at least 100 refusal trials and full published MMLU 14,042-question evaluation or pre-registered matched task subset; log model revision, tokenization, context, dtype, backend, quant scheme, hardware, clock and batch.
study_questions.D: PASS for research-source reconciliation if all 11 match. FAIL on duplicate, falsified approval, missing parent or SHA mismatch. UNCERTAIN for owner license acts, actual owner bytes, runnable archive, qualitative gain and future regulation; acquisition remains STOP.
study_questions.C: Mirage requires unavailable runtime, revised model breaks ABI, editing gains do not transfer, nano voice gains justify capacity despite overlap, referenced parent weights may already be archived with identical SHA, regional restrictions differ.
study_questions.U: No current owner D rehash or environment measurement; source links and creator evaluations only; no test replicates or quantified combined standard uncertainty u_c or coverage factor k.
